title: TOGAF: the ADM cycle and the layers of enterprise architecture

videos.script: Carcará's board has decided that by the end of 2027 every passenger will board with a digital ticket. {{title}} That one sentence touches twenty-six bus stations, three hundred buses, a fleet system bought in 2009, and the jobs of the people who sell tickets at the counter. {{touches}} No single team can design that. It is a change to the enterprise, and enterprise architecture is the discipline for it. {{enterprise}} TOGAF is the framework the corporate market asks for most. At its heart is a cycle, the ADM, that goes from a vision to a running change and back. {{adm}} It looks at the enterprise in four layers. Business, data, applications, technology. {{layers}} This lesson walks Carcará's programme around the cycle. And it ends with an honest question. How much of TOGAF does a company of forty engineers actually need?
